Ruijie Networks.why: Sells data-center Ethernet switches (400G / 800G, 128-port 800G box switch) to internet customers' AI computing-center networks; data-center switch revenue from internet customers was the core driver of its H1 2026 growth (revenue +32.83%), so AI cluster scale-out networking build-out directly drives its sales.
Ruijie Networks.evidence: Ruijie Networks half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-15-2026): the company's AI computing-center network solutions have served the large-model training and inference applications of China Mobile, Alibaba, ByteDance, Baidu, Tencent, Kuaishou, 360 and others; accelerated delivery of data-center switch orders for internet customers drove sharp revenue growth and was the core driver of H1 2026 results.

players.product: 400G/800G data-center Ethernet switches for AI computing clusters (128-port 800G box switch; 51.2T CPO co-packaged switch solution), plus 1.6T/800G optical modules

quarterly_data.quarter: Ruijie Networks half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 results (half-year report): revenue RMB 8,831,874,964.39, up 32.83% year on year, which the company attributes mainly to growth in data-center switch product revenue; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 694,194,168.56, up 53.54% (excluding non-recurring items RMB 677,058,289.13, up 56.56%) - the company says accelerated delivery of data-center switch orders for internet customers drove revenue while cost-control work also helped; operating cash flow was RMB -3,018,165,176.09 (RMB -313,898,915.14 a year earlier). R&D spending RMB 1,021,330,314.45, up 21.64%, 11.56% of revenue.

quarterly_data.quarter: Ruijie Networks half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 revenue mix (half-year report): network equipment revenue RMB 8,098,761,854.83, up 38.65%, gross margin 29.61% (down 1.40 points); domestic revenue RMB 6,713,684,135.39 (+21.98%, margin 31.73%); overseas revenue RMB 2,118,190,829.00 (+84.95%, margin 31.24%, down 10.07 points), 23.98% of revenue; direct sales RMB 5,915,347,253.05 (+51.27%, margin 25.72%) versus distribution RMB 2,916,527,711.34 (+6.49%, margin 43.58%). The company says the direct-sales share rose further as its data-center switch business for internet customers grew sharply; direct sales mainly serve operators and large internet companies, while channel sales serve government, education, healthcare, manufacturing, commercial and SMB customers.

quarterly_data.quarter: Ruijie Networks half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Internet customers (half-year report): the company's AI computing-center network solutions are widely used and have served the large-model training and inference applications of China Mobile, Alibaba, ByteDance, Baidu, Tencent, Kuaishou, 360 and others; in H1 2026 data-center switch orders for internet customers were delivered at an accelerated pace, sharply raising data-center switch revenue from the internet customer market - the core driver of the period's results. It sells mainly direct to China Mobile, China Telecom, China Unicom, Alibaba, Tencent, ByteDance and other operators and large internet companies with large sales amounts.

quarterly_data.quarter: Ruijie Networks half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Data-center switch products (half-year report): the company has a data-center switch line-up covering 400G, 800G and higher speeds for large-model training, inference and high-performance computing; it launched a 128-port 800G box switch for building high-density AI computing networks, and offers AI-Fabric and AI-FlexiForce computing-center network solutions (multi-rail networking, traffic load balancing, lossless Ethernet) for large GPU clusters. It is preparing next-generation 1.6T high-speed interconnect equipment. At the 2026 World Artificial Intelligence Conference it showed a physical demo of a super-node full rack (a demonstration).

quarterly_data.quarter: Ruijie Networks half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: CPO and optical interconnect (half-year report): the company has completed the release of a 51.2T CPO (co-packaged optics) switch commercial interconnect solution and has built a technology-route matrix covering LPO, NPO and CPO.

quarterly_data.quarter: Ruijie Networks half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Market position (half-year report, the company citing IDC data for Q1 2026): No. 1 share in China's Ethernet optical network market; No. 3 in China Ethernet switches; No. 3 in China data-center switches, of which No. 2 in 200G/400G data-center switches; data-center switches No. 2 in China's internet and manufacturing markets; No. 3 in China enterprise WLAN (No. 1 by enterprise WLAN shipments).
quarterly_data.figure: No. 3 China data-center switches; No. 2 in 200G/400G data-center switches

quarterly_data.quarter: Ruijie Networks half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Working capital (half-year report): inventory rose to RMB 5,613,872,866.19 (39.01% of total assets) from RMB 2,960,039,230.73 at the end of 2025 and cash fell to RMB 936,402,088.69 from RMB 2,525,939,298.85, both mainly because the company increased raw-material stocking; prepayments rose to RMB 1,433,233,998.94 from RMB 44,439,456.03, the largest single prepayment RMB 1,191,169,692.61 (83.11% of prepayments, counterparty not named); short-term borrowings rose to RMB 4,728,490,404.39 from RMB 1,301,276,905.54. Accounts receivable rose to RMB 3,677,368,022.95, which the company attributes to the higher share of direct-sales revenue; the top five debtors held 63.07% of receivables and contract assets (largest 27.18%) - a share of receivables, not of sales.

quarterly_data.quarter: Ruijie Networks half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Capacity (half-year report): construction in progress was RMB 75,850,655.71 at end-June 2026 (zero at the end of 2025), all for phase three of the Ruijie digital intelligent factory, which the company says is mainly a production-line expansion. Production is mostly outsourced to contract manufacturers; the company has its own production lines for some high-end products such as data-center switches.

quarterly_data.quarter: Ruijie Networks half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Key inputs (half-year report): the main raw materials for its network equipment are chips, components, optical modules, circuit boards and power modules; chips are bought mainly from external chip vendors, some from international chip makers, through a diversified supply base of international and domestic vendors. The company says switching all chips in its current products to domestic chips in the short term is not very feasible, and an adverse turn in international trade could lengthen lead times, raise prices and cause chip shortages.
